how.text: Press Play on the first artboard. Its Tweaks switch between Healthy, Low, Critical, Growth alert and First run, between a steady and a falling trend, and between light and dark. New in v2: the runway line, Identical files and Forgotten files (each with Review), the draining bar and Put Back on the result, and Space Map… in the footer. Sizes are sample data based on the 22 Oct scan, in decimal GB like Finder.
